what_matters.tag_note: SK Hynix · results out before the Seoul open
what_matters.head: SK Hynix's third-quarter revenue passed 100 trillion won for the first time, and operating profit beat forecasts. By 12:05 SGT its shares were up 10.5%, 2.2× their usual day.
what_matters.detail: Revenue was KRW 104.6tn, up 32% from Q2, and operating profit was KRW 83.3tn, an 80% margin. Analysts had expected KRW 77.5tn of operating profit (Bloomberg's estimate, via Investing.com). The company plans to return about KRW 100tn (about $75B) to shareholders for 2026, at least 30tn as dividends and at least 60tn as buybacks and cancellations. The Q3 dividend is 20,000 won a share, half of it a special dividend from its Kioxia gains. It expects memory demand to exceed supply through 2030, and long-term deals with 14 customers cover over half of its production capacity for 2027–28. The figures are provisional until the auditors finish their review. Samsung rose 9.1% (2.3× usual) a day before its own results.

what_matters.head: The Fed decides at 02:00 SGT on Thursday, and Microsoft and Alphabet report about two hours later. Samsung reports Thursday morning, then Amazon, Intel, Sandisk and AXT early on Friday SGT.
what_matters.detail: The Fed is widely expected to leave rates unchanged (Investing.com). Thursday evening SGT also brings US GDP and PCE inflation at 20:30 and the ECB decision at 21:15.

what_matters.head: Chip stocks rose on Tuesday: the chip fund gained 3.9%, 1.6× its usual day, after Broadcom announced a $63B deal late on Monday, New York time, to finance Anthropic's purchases of its AI chips.
what_matters.detail: Four financial firms, including Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley, will fund Broadcom's AI chips and equipment through a separate company that leases them to Anthropic. Instead of putting in cash up front, Broadcom guarantees the hardware's resale value, up to the amount of the senior loans. Broadcom rose 4.0%, and the gain spread to AMD (+5.5%), Intel (+3.6%) and Micron (+2.8%). An Oppenheimer analyst said the deal should ease fears about how the AI build-out gets paid for (Yahoo Finance).

latest.tape_note: The S&P 500 rose 0.6% on Tuesday and the Nasdaq 100 rose 1.3%. The chip fund led with a 3.9% gain. VIX fell 4.7%. The 10-year yield rose 1 basis point to 4.99%. US oil fell 1.8% as markets weighed the chance of easing in the Middle East conflict (Yahoo Finance), and gold rose 0.9%. The US dollar was about flat against the Singapore dollar.

recent.headline: SK Hynix's third-quarter revenue passed 100 trillion won for the first time, and operating profit beat forecasts. By 12:05 SGT its shares were up 10.5%, 2.2× their usual day.
Bloom Energy fell 11.2% on Friday, 2.2× its usual day, even though its third-quarter results beat forecasts and it raised its 2026 revenue forecast.
Chip stocks fell hard on Thursday: the chip fund lost 6.8%, 2.7× its usual day, and the Nasdaq 2.6%, its biggest one-day fall since early June.
Meta's revenue beat its own forecast, but a $9.9B legal charge cut earnings per share to $3.83, against the $5.46 analysts expected. The shares rose 2.1% after hours.
After Tuesday's US close, Super Micro raised its estimate of last quarter's revenue to $18.5–19.5B, from its forecast of $14.5–15.5B, citing demand for AI platforms.
